sources.title: Starlink satellite technology
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: OneWeb LEO：仰角與平地近似斜距
related.titleEn: OneWeb LEO: elevation and flat-Earth slant-range approximation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 15.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate 與 19.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 15.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate and 19.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋1200 km approximate slant與2400 km approximate slant，建立oneweb_geometry.csv、角度單位表、平地模型限制，並完成以下驗收：以2000 km近似斜距門檻只90度例通過；正式路由或指向必須改用球面星曆。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 1200 km approximate slant and 2400 km approximate slant; create oneweb_geometry.csv, angle units and flat-model limitations; apply this acceptance decision: Only90 degrees fits a2000 km approximate-slant limit; real routing or pointing requires spherical ephemerides.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 LEO接入只占端到端延遲的一部分；終端—衛星—閘道幾何、地面回程與排隊必須分開。 展開基準式 2*800/300000*1000+10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：按段加總並保留單向標記；不可把此數字與ping RTT直接比較或當目前Starlink服務保證。 將兩條推導一起存入 leo_segments.csv、閘道路由版本、單向/往返對照。

從原理 簡化平地幾何斜距d=h/sin(elevation)只用來教學；低仰角與遠距離時地球曲率不可省略。 展開基準式 1200/sin(radians(90))；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用直角三角形重建h=d*sin(e)，再列曲率模型所需地球半徑；勿混角度與弧度。 將兩條推導一起存入 oneweb_geometry.csv、角度單位表、平地模型限制。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from LEO access is only part of end-to-end delay; terminal/satellite/gateway geometry, terrestrial backhaul and queues need separate budgets., expand baseline expression 2*800/300000*1000+10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Sum labeled segments; do not compare the one-way estimate directly with ping RTT or present it as a current Starlink guarantee. Save both derivations with leo_segments.csv, gateway-route versions and one-way/RTT labels.

Starting from The flat-Earth approximationd=h/sin(elevation) is instructional; Earth curvature matters at low elevation and long distance., expand baseline expression 1200/sin(radians(90)); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Reconstructh=d*sin(e) and list Earth radius needed for a curved model; do not mix degrees with radians. Save both derivations with oneweb_geometry.csv, angle units and flat-model limitations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CCSDS AOS：虛擬通道配額與壅塞隔離
related.titleEn: CCSDS AOS: virtual-channel quotas and congestion isolation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 15.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate 與 19.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 15.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate and 19.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋20000 bytes for VC-A per cycle與16000 bytes for VC-A per cycle，建立aos_slots.csv、各VC累積佇列、18/14替代配置與隔離證據，並完成以下驗收：若每循環A需18000、B需14000 byte，兩種固定配額皆至少一方失敗；應提出18/14而非挑較高總量。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 20000 bytes for VC-A per cycle and 16000 bytes for VC-A per cycle; create aos_slots.csv, per-VC queue totals and evidence for an isolated18/14 alternative; apply this acceptance decision: For per-cycle demands A18000 and B14000 bytes, both proposed quotas fail one channel; propose18/14 instead of selecting by total capacity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 LEO接入只占端到端延遲的一部分；終端—衛星—閘道幾何、地面回程與排隊必須分開。 展開基準式 2*800/300000*1000+10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：按段加總並保留單向標記；不可把此數字與ping RTT直接比較或當目前Starlink服務保證。 將兩條推導一起存入 leo_segments.csv、閘道路由版本、單向/往返對照。

從原理 固定循環排程把框機會分配給虛擬通道；總容量不變時，提高一通道配額必降低另一通道保留量。 展開基準式 20*1000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：產生32列槽表，統計A/B計數20/12或16/16；兩通道交付合計永遠不超32000 byte。 將兩條推導一起存入 aos_slots.csv、各VC累積佇列、18/14替代配置與隔離證據。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from LEO access is only part of end-to-end delay; terminal/satellite/gateway geometry, terrestrial backhaul and queues need separate budgets., expand baseline expression 2*800/300000*1000+10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Sum labeled segments; do not compare the one-way estimate directly with ping RTT or present it as a current Starlink guarantee. Save both derivations with leo_segments.csv, gateway-route versions and one-way/RTT labels.

Starting from A cyclic schedule allocates frame opportunities to virtual channels; at fixed total capacity an increased quota for one reduces the reserved capacity of another., expand baseline expression 20*1000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Generate32 schedule rows and count A/B as20/12 or16/16; combined delivery never exceeds32000 bytes. Save both derivations with aos_slots.csv, per-VC queue totals and evidence for an isolated18/14 alternative.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
